claims.text: PrEP: TDF/FTC (oral) for all at-risk groups, incl injection drug use.
claims.quote: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate/emtricitabine (TDF/FTC) can be used for all at-risk populations, including those with injection drug use risk

claims.text: PrEP: TAF/FTC (oral) for sexual risk, ⍉receptive vaginal sex.
claims.quote: Tenofovir alafenamide/emtricitabine (TAF/FTC) can be used for individuals at sexual risk except those at risk via receptive vaginal sex

claims.text: PrEP injectables: cabotegravir q2mo; lenacapavir q6mo
claims.quote: Cabotegravir is administered every 2 months. Lenacapavir is administered every 6 months
In June 2025, FDA approved injectable lenacapavir (LEN), administered every 6 months, as HIV PrEP

claims.text: nPEP preferred: bictegravir/FTC/TAF, or dolutegravir + (TAF or TDF) + (FTC or lamivudine);
claims.quote: The preferred regimens for most adults and adolescents are now bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide or dolutegravir plus (tenofovir alafenamide or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate) plus (emtricitabine or lamivudine)
The recommended nPEP course is 28 days

claims.text: start ideally w.in 24-36 h, ≤72 h after exposure.
claims.quote: ideally started within 24 to 36 hours and no later than 72 hours after exposure
